targets.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dag_run WHERE execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND state = 'success'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dag_run WHERE execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND state = 'failed'
SELECT dag_id, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date - start_date))) / 60 as avg_duration FROM dag_run WHERE execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY dag_id
SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) as failures FROM task_instance WHERE state = 'failed' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY task_id ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 10
